TEXT.English: Curate Masterpiece
A hidden trigger used by Great Artists to create unique Masterpiece resources.
Consumes a Great Artist to add a globally unique Masterpiece resource to this city.
Art Curation Bonus: +1 global happiness for each era with at least 3 owned Masterpieces and each art type with at least 4 owned Masterpieces.
